project_type: React 18 + Vite SPA with PHP Slim 4 backend, Supabase BaaS
build_system: pnpm for frontend, Composer for PHP backend
test_framework: No frontend tests yet, PHPUnit for PHP backend (to create)
test_command: pnpm type-check && pnpm lint && pnpm build
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm type-check - must pass with zero errors. 2. Run pnpm lint - must pass. 3. Run pnpm build - must succeed. 4. Run composer install in server/php/ - must succeed. 5. PHP syntax check on all PHP files.
setup_instructions: pnpm install in root. composer install in server/php/.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - can install packages. Node.js 22, PHP 8.4, Composer available via mise.
contribution_requirements: TypeScript strict mode (zero errors). PHP 8.2+ with strict types. All API endpoints documented. Build must pass.

key_patterns.frontend_pages: Pages use mock data arrays, motion/react animations, shadcn UI components, DataTable, PageHeader. Each page is a default export in src/pages/.
key_patterns.hooks: Only useAuth.ts, useDebounce.ts, useMediaQuery.ts exist. TanStack Query is installed but not used for data fetching yet.
key_patterns.supabase: Client at src/lib/supabase.ts. Uses VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY env vars.
key_patterns.ai_service: 6 agents with system prompts in src/services/ai/agents/. Provider layer with proxy pattern in providers.ts. Mock responses as fallback.
key_patterns.types: Database types in src/types/database.ts match the Supabase schema. Note: DB schema uses slightly different column names (e.g. company_name vs name, purchase_price vs cost_price) than the TS types.
key_patterns.design_system: Dark glassmorphism theme: bg #0a0a0a, text #f4f4f4/#a1a1aa, accent #10b981. glass class with backdrop-blur. Cards 24px radius, buttons 16px, inputs 12px.
key_patterns.docker: Simple Dockerfile builds frontend with nginx. docker-compose.yml has single app service.

directory_structure: Root: React SPA with Vite. src/components/{ui,layout,shared,auth}. src/pages/{ai,auth,crm,inventory,procurement,reports,sales,settings}. src/services/{ai,excel}. src/hooks/. src/contexts/. supabase/migrations/. New: server/php/ (to create), supabase/functions/ (to create).
